sloka: सूचकः च कदर्यः च मित्र्घ्नो गुरुतल्पगः ।लोकं पापात्मानम् एते गच्छन्ते न अत्र संशयः ॥४-१७-३७॥
transliteration: sūcakaḥ ca kadaryaḥ ca mitrghno gurutalpagaḥ ।lokaṁ pāpātmānam ete gacchante na atra saṁśayaḥ ॥4-17-37॥

translations.english: 'My skin is not fit to be worn by the virtuous, my hair and bones are also prohibited from any use. My flesh is also not at all fit to be eaten by righteous people like you
translations.hindi: हे हरिपुङ्गव '| इस विषय के और भी कारण हैं, में उन्हें भी तुम्हें वतलाता हूँ । उनको सुनकर तुम अपने मन का क्रोध त्याग दो
